instruction: Configure Chrome to display all website prices in Euros regardless of the original currency.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have built-in functionality to automatically convert and display all prices in a specific currency. Currency conversion on websites is managed by the websites themselves or specialized extensions, not by Chrome's native settings.
